caribbean.headline: Roatan Faces 23 kt Winds, 75% Rain Probability
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing sustained 23 kt winds, 5.6 ft waves, and 75% rain probability. I also see Turks & Caicos with 21 kt winds.

mediterranean.headline: Dubrovnik Calm, Low Rain, Moderate Winds
mediterranean.paragraph: Dubrovnik is experiencing maximum winds of 11 kt and waves up to 1.8 ft, with a 25% rain probability, and I note the swell period of 7 s from the west. Lisbon sees winds up to 12 kt, and I see calm conditions elsewhere in the Central Mediterranean.
